cases.instruction: Insert the node "Query Data Tool" of type "@n8n/n8n-nodes-langchain.vectorStoreInMemory" between "Upload your file here" and "Insert Data to Store". Set parameters to: {"mode": "retrieve-as-tool", "memoryKey": {"__rl": true, "mode": "list", "value": "vector_store_key"}}.
Insert the node "Redirect to Completion Screen" of type "n8n-nodes-base.form" between "Clear For Next Interview" and "Get Session". Set parameters to: {"respondWith": "redirect"}.

Insert the node "Update Sheets data" of type "n8n-nodes-base.googleSheets" between "Run Workflow" and "Get Rows from Google Sheets". Set parameters to: {"documentId": {"__rl": true, "mode": "list", "value": "15i9WIYpqc5lNd5T4VyM0RRptFPdi9doCbEEDn8QglN4", "cachedResultUrl": "https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/15i9WIYpqc5lNd5T4VyM0RRptFPdi9doCbEEDn8QglN4/edit?usp=drivesdk", "cachedResultName": "Sample Data"}, "sheetName": {"__rl": true, "mode": "list", "value": "gid=0", "cachedResultUrl": "https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/15i9WIYpqc5lNd5T4VyM0RRptFPdi9doCbEEDn8QglN4/edit#gid=0", "cachedResultName": "Sheet1"}}.

Insert the node "Post Twitter" of type "n8n-nodes-base.httpRequest" between "If" and "No Operation, do nothing". Set parameters to: {"specifyBody": "json", "method": "POST", "genericAuthType": "httpBearerAuth", "options": {}}.

Insert the node "Add Task" of type "n8n-nodes-base.googleSheets" between "Write Json" and "Respond Complete". Set parameters to: {"documentId": {"__rl": true, "mode": "list", "value": "1pbK-B-Q9p8fVjxJIsjEVrAfRgqEPCeYw8rZojZPAb84", "cachedResultUrl": "https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1pbK-B-Q9p8fVjxJIsjEVrAfRgqEPCeYw8rZojZPAb84/edit?usp=drivesdk", "cachedResultName": "Project Manager"}, "options": {}}.

Insert the node "OPENAI - Get messages" of type "n8n-nodes-base.httpRequest" between "OPENAI - Run assistant" and "Send Message to User". Set parameters to: {"authentication": "predefinedCredentialType", "options": {}, "sendHeaders": true}.

Insert the node "Upload Chunk" of type "n8n-nodes-base.httpRequest" between "Chunk" and "Loop Over Chunks". Set parameters to: {"contentType": "multipart-form-data", "method": "POST", "url": "={{ $('Configuration').item.json.fileflows_url }}/api/library-file/upload"}.
Insert the node "LinkedIn Image generator" of type "@n8n/n8n-nodes-langchain.openAi" between "AI Content creator" and "Post image Cloudianry LIn". Set parameters to: {}.
Insert the node "Extract from Text" of type "n8n-nodes-base.extractFromFile" between "Switch" and "Postgres PGVector Store". Set parameters to: {"operation": "text"}.
Insert the node "Instagram params" of type "n8n-nodes-base.set" between "When clicking ‘Test workflow’" and "Instagram prepare media". Set parameters to: {"options": {}}.
Insert the node "X1" of type "n8n-nodes-base.twitter" between "Wait" and "Split Out". Set parameters to: {"additionalFields": {}}.
Insert the node "Edit Fields" of type "n8n-nodes-base.set" between "Aggregate" and "Create or update a record". Set parameters to: {"options": {}}.
Insert the node "Google Search" of type "n8n-nodes-base.httpRequest" between "Edit Fields" and "Extract Competitor Data". Set parameters to: {"url": "https://www.googleapis.com/customsearch/v1"}.
Insert the node "limit order code" of type "n8n-nodes-base.code" between "Limit Order (POST)" and "Respond to Limit Order". Set parameters to: {}.
Insert the node "Currency/Symble List" of type "n8n-nodes-base.set" between "Check Market is open/close" and "Fetch Stock Market Data". Set parameters to: {}.

Insert the node "Extract Query Data" of type "n8n-nodes-base.set" between "Receive User Question" and "Route to Appropriate Level". Set parameters to: {"assignments": {"assignments": [{"id": "userQuery", "name": "userQuery", "type": "string", "value": "={{ $json.message.text }}"}, {"id": "chatId", "name": "chatId", "type": "string", "value": "={{ $json.message.chat.id }}"}, {"id": "timestamp", "name": "timestamp", "type": "string", "value": "={{ $now.toISO() }}"}]}}.
Insert the node "When to send" of type "n8n-nodes-base.if" between "Calculate Waiting Time" and "Wait to send 1h before meeting". Set parameters to: {"options": {}}.

Insert the node "Scrape URLs from results" of type "n8n-nodes-base.code" between "Search Google Maps with query" and "Filter irrelevant URLs". Set parameters to: {"jsCode": "const data = $input.first().json.data

const regex = /https?:\/\/[^\/]+/g

const urls = data.match(regex)

return urls.map(url => ({json: {url: url}}))"}.
